static int counter;

int next(int step) {
    int counter = step;
    {
        int counter = 2;
        counter++;
    }
    return counter;
}

union value {
    int whole;
    float part;
};

int read_all(int fd, char *buffer, int size) {
    int total = 0;
    while (total < size) {
        int got = read(fd, buffer + total, size - total);
        if (got <= 0) {
            break;
        }
        total += got;
    }
    return total;
}
